SG. Today the demo does not
:80/:443 from the agent SG + ALL from itself
this, not routing, is what admits path 3
AgentCore runtime ENI → VIP → pod. Runs today.
AgentCore Gateway → Lattice ENIs → VIP → pod. Not built — needs a publicly trusted cert.
a caller in the VPC → VIP → pod. Runs today, but see the caveat.
CAVEAT on path 3, tested 2026-08-20: the jumphost reaches the VIP only through its bnk-ext NIC. Forced out of the public-1 NIC instead, the same request is dropped
(000 vs 200) — the bnk-data SG does not admit the jumphost SG. So today's “stranger” sits inside BNK's own data-plane security group. A stranger in public-2 would be the honest test.
